airplane: visible aircraft body with wings and tail, compact object-level structure, and clear airplane contours.
airport: large aviation area with broad paved runways, terminal-like facilities, and organized airport infrastructure.
baseball_diamond: compact sports field with a clear diamond-shaped infield and surrounding outfield.
basketball_court: small rectangular court surface with clear hard-court markings.
beach: bright shoreline region with clear sand-water boundary and open coastal texture.
bridge: narrow man-made crossing structure spanning water or land.
chaparral: dry shrub-covered terrain with coarse natural texture and sparse woody vegetation.
church: prominent religious building or complex with distinctive landmark-like architecture and surrounding open space.
circular_farmland: cultivated land with large regular circular irrigation patterns.
cloud: bright amorphous atmospheric mass with soft edges and no stable ground texture.
commercial_area: dense urban business district with organized building blocks, roads, and large man-made structures.
dense_residential: tightly packed residential roofs with very high housing density and minimal spacing.
desert: broad barren region with dry homogeneous texture and very little vegetation.
forest: dense continuous tree canopy with dark green natural texture.
freeway: wide multi-lane transportation corridor with continuous linear flow and road-network structure.
golf_course: large landscaped green field with fairways, lawns, and designed open-course layout.
ground_track_field: sports venue with an oval running track and central field.
harbor: waterfront maritime area with docks, vessels, and shore-adjacent port infrastructure.
industrial_area: large factory-like compounds with heavy infrastructure, storage yards, and production-oriented layouts.
intersection: road junction where multiple transportation lines meet.
island: landmass completely surrounded by water with clear shoreline boundary.
lake: large enclosed inland water body with smooth water surface and clear boundary.
meadow: broad natural grass-covered open area with soft vegetation texture and weak structural boundaries.
medium_residential: moderately spaced residential houses with visible yards and neighborhood streets.
mobile_home_park: repetitive small elongated housing units arranged in orderly rows.
mountain: rugged elevated terrain with strong relief, slope shadows, and irregular topographic texture.
overpass: elevated crossing transport structure with visible grade separation.
palace: large landmark complex with symmetrical layout, open courtyards, and prominent architecture.
parking_lot: large open paved area with organized parking rows and vehicle-oriented layout.
railway: elongated rail corridor with parallel tracks and linear transport structure.
railway_station: transport hub with concentrated rail lines and station-related structures.
rectangular_farmland: cultivated land divided into regular rectangular parcels.
river: elongated natural watercourse with continuous winding channel and visible banks.
roundabout: circular traffic junction with a central island and radiating roads.
runway: long straight paved strip with elongated linear geometry and open airport-like surroundings.
sea_ice: bright frozen surface with irregular cracked or slab-like texture over water.
ship: discrete vessel object on water with elongated hull-like structure.
snowberg: bright snow- or ice-covered elevated landform with strong cold-tone texture.
sparse_residential: widely separated residential houses with large open gaps and low housing density.
stadium: large sports complex with prominent field and stronger enclosure or spectator-related structure.
storage_tank: clusters of large circular industrial tanks with highly regular round geometry.
tennis_court: small rectangular court surfaces with clear line markings and repeated court geometry.
terrace: stepped agricultural or hillside bands following slope contours.
thermal_power_station: large power-generation complex with heavy industrial structures, chimneys, or cooling-related facilities.
wetland: water-rich natural area with mixed shallow water and vegetation patches.
